access_gaps.title: Jaegos House licensing variation 25/00949/LIPV, 8 May 2025 minutes and public report
access_gaps.error: Official minutes available through the web search index; direct HTML download returned 403. Supporting 4 MB public report not retrieved. Not archived as a complete source.
access_gaps.research_observation: Indexed minutes record the operator representative saying around 1,400 registered members and both sites 100% subscribed; membership unit not defined. Existing licence from July 2022; 2025 variation adds the Lodge. This is not a verified household count or physical occupancy limit.

notes: No changes made to the main catalogue, register or indexes; parent to merge KP01–KP07.
Key PNG extracts are derivatives of KP02 and KP06, not separate independent sources.
Planning Atlas was used to discover official document links; core area findings were verified in the official PDFs.
